user.title: OCPP Hub
user.description: Set the port your charger connects to. In the charger's OCPP profile, use ws:// followed by the address of this Home Assistant, a colon and this port.

data_description.port: The TCP port the OCPP server listens on. A port above 1024 needs no special rights.

abort.single_instance_allowed: OCPP Hub is already set up.
